issues.description: generate-stories requires an existing stories manifest for topics, so a clean checkout cannot bootstrap the missing dataset.
README advertises make demo/emovec all --tiny as runnable, but the required data/stories files are absent from the repo.
Story loading ignores manifest integrity and does not validate missing, empty, or mismatched story files before extraction.
The only story dataset test is skipped when data is missing, hiding the clean-checkout failure from default tests.
Steering integration test only checks that Elo changes, not that the shift direction matches the claimed correlation.
Checked-in steering results show negative correlation_vs_shift and a negative-correlated emotion increasing steered Elo.
PCA computation can emit NaNs on zero-variance input and does not validate variance_target bounds.
emotion_vectors silently produces NaNs if any configured emotion has no labeled examples.
Neutral activation capture materializes all token/layer/hidden activations at once, which can OOM on realistic corpora.
Story-generation HTTP requests have no timeout, retry, or response-status handling and can hang indefinitely.
Bearer API key is sent to arbitrary EMOVEC_API_BASE without scheme or host validation, making secret leakage easy on misconfiguration.
Runtime dependencies are lower-bound only with no lock/constraints, making model behavior and installs non-reproducible.
Model loading uses dtype= with a broad transformers lower bound, risking incompatibility or ignored dtype behavior across installs.
Generated egg-info and outputs are present in the tree despite ignore rules, creating source/provenance hygiene debt.
Importing the package mutates global USER, LOGNAME, and TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR environment variables.
